checks.subject: AURORA Dimensional Explorer — sequential keyboard focus order and keyboard selection

measured.order_observed: header actions (btn-reset-proj first; btn-undo disabled until a projection change exists and correctly skipped) → encoding slot selects + lin/log toggles → dimension rail summaries/filter controls → filter chips when present → record table rows (…AUR-1040, AUR-1041, AUR-1042)
measured.note: v2 measurement: 60 fixed Tab presses with focus identity taken from the index in the recomputed tabbable list — Tab order is monotonic in DOM order with no stalls and visible focus at every stop; keyboard selection operable without pointer. Supersedes the v1 run (9 steps), whose stop key aliased identical <summary> signatures and stopped early on a false repeat; no implementation change occurred between the two runs.

threshold.rule: every interactive element reachable via sequential keyboard focus in DOM order; focus visibly indicated; selection operable without pointer

supported_fixes: styles.css: scoped .state-note overlay to #region-data so the inspector empty state could not intercept pointer/focus page-wide
app.js renderTable: restores keyboard focus to the same record's row (preventScroll) after re-render so ArrowDown navigation is continuous
measurement v2: focus identity by tabbable-list index (v1's tag|id|class key aliased identical <summary> elements and stopped early)

binding.scenario: explore-dimensional-data: user swaps dimensions across X/Y/color/size encoding slots; selection, filters, and inspector binding survive every switch; filter chips and projection undo/reset provide owned, reversible state; first paint renders ~1200 inlined records with no loading state
